title: Revocation
description: Key, policy, permit or run identifier plus effective time (plan: 'Wire contracts'). Net-new. issuer (envelope field) is expected to be an assurance-signer identity, distinct from policy authors/approvers/tool executors (plan: 'Fixed trust boundary'); this schema does not itself check the issuer's role — role bindings are deployment configuration (plan: 'Wire contracts').

revoked_id.description: key_id, policy digest, permit action_digest or run_id depending on revoked_type
